Current vacancies

Senior Software Engineer - posted 28th April

AMF is recruiting a UK-based senior software engineer to add to the team. They will be an experienced full stack developer specialising in .NET Core and SQL Server. They will report to, and work closely with, AMF's Head of Technology, and will be able to take projects from initial analysis through to completion and manage small projects involving others. A successful candidate has the potential to take on increasing responsibility within AMF: the role offers the chance to develop both technical and management skills and make a significant impact to AMF's work.

More details can be found on our recent blog post.

Junior Software Engineer - posted 28th April

AMF is recruiting a UK-based developer specialising in Python and SQL Server, with opportunities to learn .NET Core. They will report to AMF's Head of Technology, working closely with the rest of the AMF team and liaising with technology partners based in programme countries.

More details can be found on our recent blog post.
